DK mini-MAX family: 150-entry personal cap, large-field top-heavy GPP. Observed 2026-07-29 on 'MLB $15K mini-MAX [150 Entry Max]': 17835-entrant field, paid to 4097th, 1st $1500/2nd $750/3rd $300, breadth computed at 4097/17835. Re-verify field size/payout if a different dollar-amount instance is entered.

DK Triple Up family: a fixed count of top finishers each win a flat 3x the entry fee and nothing below, so every paid place pays the same and rank inside the paid zone is worth nothing. OBSERVED on the 19 MLB instances in data/reference/draftkings-contest-entry-history_2026-10-09.csv (16 Classic, 3 Showdown): MLB $1 Triple Up [Top 9 Win $3], $1 entry, field 26 to 31, top 9 each win $3, prize pool $27, so breadth 9 of 31 = 0.29 (0.35 at a field of 26). The objective is clearing a 29% line, the Double Up geometry at 3x, so this row is cash/flat_cash and NOT satellite (no tickets, so it would raise false ticket_count gaps and build in WTA mode) and NOT wta (the 2% Micro Booster geometry). The bracket in the title is the paid count: Top 3 and Top 18 variants exist on other sports at 9 and 62 entrants, so re-verify field size and paid count on a different bracket before trusting 0.29. LABELLED CONVENTION 2026-10-16 (Session 148, DEV judgment from the observed curve; Ben can overrule). See R196.

DK Micro Booster family: flat prize to a handful of top finishers, nothing below, so a non-winning finish pays exactly what last place pays. OBSERVED 2026-08-30 on 'MLB 40x Micro Booster [Top 5 Win $10] (Afternoon)' (194681833): 237-entrant field, top 5 each win $10 on a $0.25 entry, breadth 5/237. The 40x in the title is the payout multiple, not the field size. Re-verify field size and paid count on a different dollar instance; the family name does not fix them.

DK Solo Shot family: single entry, but a BROAD and shallow curve, not the 1%-breadth single_entry_gpp shape. OBSERVED 2026-08-30 on 'MLB $1.25K Solo Shot (Afternoon)' (194686507): 1486 entrants, paid to 350th (23.5%), 1st $125 / 2nd $100 / 3rd $80 / 4th $65 / 5th $50 / 6th $35, then 7-8 $25, 9-10 $15, 11-15 $10, 16-25 $5, 26-50 $3, 51-100 $2.50, 101-180 $2, 181-350 $1.50. Barbell: top 10 hold $535 of $1250 (43%) and ranks 51-350 hold $540 (43%). payout_shape_default is deliberately broad_micro_gpp and NOT single_entry_gpp, because single_entry_gpp is inside WTA_CONSTRUCTION_SHAPES and would build max-concentration for a curve that pays a quarter of the field. inferred_type stays se_gpp because the entry cap really is 1. RESOLVED 2026-10-16 (Session 148, D-12, Ben): normalize_posture reads this row's pair (se_gpp, broad_micro_gpp) and returns small_gpp, so posture inference now drives it and no --postures is needed. small_gpp is a LABELLED CONVENTION, the posture the hand overrides had been passing, until a graded Solo Shot cohort says otherwise.
